item.summary: Goobit has signed an agreement with Kvarn Metals, which will be the counterparty for gold in its Futureproof savings platform, the company told Kaupr. According to Goobit, the gold is backed 1:1 by physical gold, while bitcoin comes from Kvarn Capital under an agreement made in September. Goobit says both asset classes it needs for launch are now in place.
